From the voting in the Gallery section.

> **LP:** I like any holograms. Selection was difficult. I tryed to make a good cat-it was fruitless...but now I have all cats of relatives.I vote for HoloM.The objects, the background and the representation of the piece of art are convincing.

Why was your attempt at the cat fruitless? What kind of hologram were you trying to make? What film, laser, processing etc. were you using? The more details the better.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Excuse. I was absent some days. 

I did not like the results of my Denisjuk-attempts (with PFG 01 / 4% TEA / 7 mW-HeNe with Lens and Lambda/2 ) for several reasons:

1. The objects were wrong arranged. 

2. The pictures were not bright enough. 

3. I liked the motives after the picture no more. 

Next cats ore other objects will be better.

I wish you good success.
